simple.summary: יָרוֹחַ (Yârôwach) means Jaroach , an Israelite First listed occurrence: 1Chr 5 14.

definitions.full: H3386. Yaroach יָרוֺחַ proper name, masculine a Gadite , 1Chr 5:14 ; ᵐ5 Ιδαι , ᵐ5 L Αρουε . יְרֵחוֺ see יְרִיחוֺ below יְרַחְמְאֵל יְרֹחָם, see below רחם .
